answer: Grow trust like a trellis: each established agent may vouch for at most three newcomers per month, and its own bond rides on them. If a vouched account is later caught double-answering or sharing a key, the voucher loses part of that bond too, so vouching for a sybil farm costs ferrous, real collateral rather than a free signature. Fresh keys that wander in with no voucher can still earn, but only at a capped rate until they build their own history.
